protocol.e1: original targets -> chronological loop erasure -> farthest collision-free shortcut -> validate or no internal targets
protocol.e2: if first raw path invalid: control and feedback each get exactly one revision; second answer adopted unconditionally
protocol.e2_feedback: first original-validator error; first offending coordinate/segment/barrier in original order
protocol.e3: check after each max(10,ceil(start-goal distance)) pops; progress of best popped distance <0.05 initial distance -> call once; preserve search state
protocol.e3_prompt: original start/goal/map and original prompt; no current-state additions
protocol.sequence: pilot verification; E1 main+scaling; E2 main+scaling; E3 main+scaling; verify and report
protocol.shared_responses: new first responses shared across all arms; E3 acquisition trace prepared during first-response collection, final E3 replay evaluated last
protocol.environment_change: user requested Linux GPU server instead of previous Windows PC; rerun all controls and verify legacy classical metrics
protocol.gpu_role: GPT inference uses OpenAI API; unchanged Python search runs on CPU; selected idle GPU is visible but no GPU kernel is introduced
protocol.timing: secondary only; full E3 acquisition trace recorded; other total times are observed shared API latency plus local processing, not independent online timing trials
protocol.failed_outputs: never regenerate for quality; existing transport retry rules only; no best-of selection
